nodes.label: Bullet Classes Embedded in Chrono
nodes.rationale: A modified copy of Bullet is vendored into the tree as one option for Chrono's collision detection system.

nodes.label: cbt Prefix Renaming
nodes.rationale: Every embedded Bullet file and class was renamed from the standard bt prefix to cbt to prevent linker collisions with a system Bullet installation or with downstream projects that already link Bullet.

nodes.label: repren Automated Renaming Recipe
nodes.rationale: The rename is reproducible rather than manual: repren --from="bt([A-Z0-9].*?)" --to='cbt\1' --full run from src/ rewrites modules, demos and tests alike, followed by deleting the *.orig files.

nodes.label: ***CHRONO*** Change Markers
nodes.rationale: Local divergences from upstream Bullet are tagged in-source with the string ***CHRONO*** so they can be found and re-applied when the vendored copy is refreshed.
